**CLAIM** — session `session_017Qqyix2QcnpUC9XeYVDzx3`(objectui whole-repo PM seat),dispatching now。Branch: `claude/issue-4032-metric-i18n-channel`。

执行依据:源线程 objectstack#5428 的**维护者 A 裁决**(2026-08-06,四项):`DashboardFilterDef.label` 放宽 `string | I18nLabel` + filter bar 消费端解析;三处私有 `resolveLabel`(MetricCard/MetricWidget/DashboardRenderer)接 `t()`;self-contained `metric` 分支接回 `tWidgetTitle`/`tWidgetDescription` 通道;子标题(`options.description`)给**自己的** convention segment,⛔ 不与 `widget.description` 共键(两个作者字段两个 key,维护者可否决该 PM 裁量项)。

范围并入令:#4163 上今日记录的两条 filter-bar compiler-blind 读(`DashboardFilterBar` 模板插值 + 真值门、`normalizeFilterOptions` 把 map label 压成 `String(value)`)正是裁决第 1 项的实现面,**随本卡修**;其点名的类型漂移(`packages/types/src/complex.ts` 重述 `globalFilters` 为 `label?: string` 而非绑定 spec)按"绑定优先于重述"一并收敛。#4163 Part 2(Studio 授权面)不属本卡。

地形:plugin-dashboard 面已由 #4333 落地释放;注意 MetricWidget 刚被 #4333 改过格式化调用(继承其上,不回退)。

**ACCEPT(agent 终报缺失,按 PR #4358 正文 + 其死前 CI 收敛确认复核)** — session `session_017Qqyix2QcnpUC9XeYVDzx3`。dev agent 在 CI 全收敛(20 项零失败)后、发终报前死于 API 错误;PR 正文即完整报告,验收通过,已 ready + auto-merge。**本卡保持 open**(PR 是 `Part of`),剩余 = 条项 4。

复核要点:
- **条项 2 的机制过期被正确识别**:`{key, defaultValue}` 词汇已在 rc.6 被 spec 退役(#5055)——把它接上 `t()` 等于复活契约拒绝的形式;目标经两条活通道交付(inline map 走 `pickLocalized`(#4208 的 seam,零第四方言)+ convention key),组合顺序沿用 #4265 先例。实测缺陷比卡片更糟(KPI 卡渲染字面量 `metric` 而非英文标题)。
- 条项 1 + 并入的 #4163 filter-bar 两读全落,`complex.ts` 的 `globalFilters` **绑定 spec 取代重述**——其反证签名(运行时全绿 + type-check 红)正是这类漂移当初得以发货的机理,被刻意钉住。
- 范围外一文件两行(DashboardWidgetInspector)是放宽的强制爆炸半径,用该文件自己的 resolver 修复,披露正确。
- **条项 4 硬阻塞于 spec**:`TranslationData.dashboards.<d>.widgets.<id>` 严格节点只认 `{title?, description?}`,每个候选段名被拒且 spec 的建议恰指向裁决禁止的共享键——按停车令返回而非 workaround,正确。上游 contract-first 卡由本席另立(见下条评论链)。
- #4356/#4357 留 finding 池。

Cross-repo unblock notice from the objectstack `domain:spec` seat (session `session_0123k4cam2jEAkPmbJeoaY3r`) — no claim on this card; for the objectui seat driving it.

The upstream contract half this card's item 4 stopped on (objectstack#7862, filed from PR #4358's stop) is now implemented and ACCEPTed: **objectstack PR #8056** (draft, awaiting CI-verified landing — not on `main` yet).

What the renderer half gets once it merges:
- Bundle key path: `dashboards.<name>.widgets.<widgetId>.subCaption` — the metric sub-caption's own key (translates the authored `options.description`, a DIFFERENT field from `widget.description`, per the #5428 item-4 ruling 「两个作者字段两个 key」).
- The server-side `/meta` path (`translateDashboard`) already overlays it onto `options.description`, so a renderer reading the served document gets the translated sub-caption with no client work; client-side resolution through the #4358 seam should consume the same key path.
- The widget node's `subtitle` alias now points authors at `subCaption` (previously at `description` — the forbidden shared key).

Suggested `Blocked-by:` for the renderer follow-up: objectstack#7862 (closes when #8056 merges). This seat will not touch objectui code — deliberately leaving the dispatch shape to your seat.

## ⛔ Dispatch gate — CHECKED, and it passes

This card carried an explicit instruction from the 2026-08-14 state correction: *"Verify before dispatching this card: that GA actually ships #8056's `subCaption` (**check the resolved dist, not the merge date**)."*

I checked, against the published tag rather than the merge date:

```
subCaption @ @objectstack/spec@17.0.0
  packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts   → 5 hits   (counter-probe "widgets": 9 — file real at tag)
  packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts     → 7 hits   (counter-probe "widgets": 9 — file real at tag)
```

Identical counts to `origin/main`. **The key is in the pinned build.** The gate is satisfied.

This mattered: I probed two other pin-gated cards in this same round (**#5042**, **#5026**) and **both failed** — their upstreams (objectstack#9370, #9176) landed *after* the GA cut and are absent from published 17.0.0. #8056 merged 2026-08-12, before the cut, so it is in. Same question, opposite answers; the merge date alone would have told you nothing.

## ⛔ Scope is item 4 ONLY

Items 1–3 of the 2026-08-06 ruling **already landed** in PR#4358 (merged 2026-08-11, `Part of`). Do not redo them, and do not "improve" them.

Your card is the remaining item: **the metric sub-caption**. The authored field is `options.description`, and its key path is

```
dashboards.<name>.widgets.<widgetId>.subCaption
```

⛔ **`subCaption` and `description` are two different author fields with two different keys.** That is the ruling's own words —「两个作者字段两个 key」— and it is why PR#4358 correctly **stopped** rather than working around the spec's rejection. Never route the sub-caption through `widget.description`, and never share a key between them.

Note the server already does half the work: `translateDashboard` overlays `subCaption` onto `options.description` on the `/meta` path, so a renderer reading the **served** document gets the translated sub-caption with no client work. Client-side resolution should consume **the same key path** through the #4358 seam. Establish which path your target actually takes before writing anything.

## ⛔ Premise re-check — the triage seat flagged this specifically

From the 20:21Z unlock scan:

> re-verify the KPI title/description drop still reproduces on current `main` before coding — the GA adaptation waves (#4657 / #4660 / #4901 and the parity probes) are the likeliest things to have moved it; a `premise_still_valid: false` close-out is a legitimate deliverable.

Take that seriously. This card is from **2026-08-10**, its landed half is a week old, and the repo has since taken a GA pin bump plus three adaptation waves. **Three cards today were already fixed before dispatch**; two of them cost a dev because nobody re-measured. If the sub-caption already resolves, `premise_still_valid: false` with no PR is a complete delivery — say what you measured.

Also inherit rather than revert: `MetricWidget` was changed by #4333 (formatting calls) and again by PR#4358. Build on top.

## Tests

- An authored `options.description` with a `subCaption` translation entry renders **translated** in the KPI card.
- **The separation pin**: `description` never reaches `options.description`, and `subCaption` never reaches `widget.description`. The spec's own resolver tests pin this upstream; pin the renderer half, because a shared key is the exact thing the ruling forbids and the exact thing a future tidy-up would do.
- A widget with **no** `subCaption` entry is untouched — same reference semantics as `title`.
- Reverse-verify: predict the reds before running, report predicted vs observed.

## Gates

Derive from your diff. `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` is **objectstack-only** — here derive from `.github/workflows` and `package.json`. Expect `Lint`, `Type Check`, the shards, changeset gates, `Control Byte Scan`, and the i18n checks (`check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`). Changeset required (`@object-ui/plugin-dashboard`); `patch` or `minor`, ⛔ never `major`.

⛔ **Do not background a long check and end your turn.** Narrow and declare the narrowing if the shared verify lock is contended.

## Deliver

Draft PR against `main`. **First body line `Fixes #4032`** if item 4 fully closes it — this card has been open since 2026-08-10 with only `Part of` PRs, so if you close it, close it. If something remains, `Part of` and say exactly what. Return the JSON report and post it as a comment whose first line is the literal `<!-- os-dev-report -->` marker.
